messages.author: 28f7cf43544f2467
messages.subject: Specify Fill Colors
parts:
I am generating a heat map plot and assigning colors using the
following call to scale_fill_gradient:

scale_fill_gradient(name="ODs",limits=c
(zmin,zmax),low="red",high="steelblue")

I am finding that I would like to discern the ranges of values a bit
better than the transition from one color to another allows (see
example here http://ggplot2.googlegroups.com/web/example.jpg).

I'm looking for some advice on how to specify the exact colors used
for each range of values in a heat map plot. I would like to specify
4-5 unique colors that get assigned for each value range.

Any help/advice is appreciated.

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Specify Fill Colors
parts:
Hi,

You could perhaps cut your continuous variable into 5 ranges, and use
scale_fill_manual() with the colours of your choice.

HTH,

baptiste
